anchors.invariant: opaque VM material is _opaque/vms/<id>/, vsock-injected, never on VM struct/StateStore/API views
unsigned blobs, mode 0600, not Gordian envelopes
foreign-origin browser never holds the Mjolnir JWT; wrug /term is the attach path
@base/ is OS roots not toolchains; snapshots are spawnable and not catalog entries
user Elect, IdentiKey Sign+Auth; Honor is a device credential not a second XID Sign key

inherited.fact: Folding an architecture-plus-one-slice change must not import unimplemented SHALLs into openspec/specs/. This architecture change folds the ADR only.
SecretStore envelope API cannot hold an unsigned nsec; _opaque/vms/<id>/ is the store namespace. Guest inject_identity is in-tree.
Foreign-origin web terminals terminate on a trusted edge; browser does not open the Mjolnir PTY WebSocket with a JWT.
